  <li><strong>&#x27;One Nation, One Election&#x27; roadmap:</strong> The JPC chief stated that implementing simultaneous elections by 2029 is feasible, provided necessary constitutional amendments are passed and state support is secured.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial transfer policy:</strong> The Supreme Court Collegium, led by the Chief Justice of India, has formally approved a new policy facilitating the early transfer of High Court Chief Justices.</li>
</ul>
